domain.doc: Calculate centroid for whole geometry (detail), per piece (pieces), or per primitive (primitives)

method.doc: Calculation method: area-weighted center of mass or bounding box center

output.doc: Output mode: create new points at centroid locations, or add a centroid attribute to input geometry

attribute_name.doc: Attribute name to write when output is set to attribute

transfer_attribute.doc: Space-separated names or wildcard pattern of attributes to transfer from pieces to centroid points
